Small businesses don’t have small ambitions.

Meet Hiroki, a broccoli farmer putting ChatGPT to work behind the scenes of his farm.

Today, we’re introducing ChatGPT for Small Businesses—a new program bringing together AI tools, practical education, and resources to help owners and lean teams spend less time on busywork and more time building.

Watch Hiroki’s story and learn more: https://openai.com/index/introducing-chatgpt-small-business-program/
